description:
## [1.1.0](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kagebili/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-11-06)

### ✨ New Features

* more ui debloat option ([ddd8ee0](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kagebili/commit/ddd8ee05537e946bb1319fad73fb133aaaee1a22))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* simplify patches option ([69d30dc](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kagebili/commit/69d30dc9d4909d16ab3cec6ee5b3ba77f2f82010))

patches.name: Clean interface
patches.description: Customizes Home, navigation, account and search surfaces, and optional rating prompts.

options.description: Hides Home search unless single-page simplification keeps native search visible.
Hides the Featured / For You tab from the home tab bar.
Hides the Plaza / Channel tab from the home tab bar.
Hides promotional, event, and activity tabs (e.g. Dapatkan Itabag, Gratis Sementara, limited-time events).
Hides the Subscriptions tab from the home tab bar.
Hides the Anime tab from the home tab bar.
Hides the Shorts tab from the home tab bar.
Hides the Community (Opus) tab from the home tab bar.
Shows native search and hides the tab row when Home has exactly one installed page.
Hides the Discover tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Hides the center Create (+) button from the bottom navigation bar.
Hides the Chats (Messages) tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Hides the Me (Profile) tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Hides the Shorts tab from the bottom navigation bar if present.
Hides the Creator Center dashboard card and banner buttons.
Hides promotional/campaign menus.
Hides Help & FAQs menus.
Hides Feedback and report menus.
Hides trending search hot words and suppresses the network request.
Hides discovery section modules, tabs, and dividers on the search landing page.
Neutralizes promotional default keywords and forces the default 'Search' hint.
Hides the sliding tab strip and ViewPager2 content on the Discover page.
Hides trending searches and suppresses loading spinner on the Discover page.
Disables unsolicited app rating dialogs.

patches.name: Clean player
patches.description: Hides selected player branding, recommendations, outro cards and optional comments and danmaku.

options.description: Hides the top-right brand logo and copyright/premium watermark in the video player.
Disables fullscreen video player bottom-right recommendation widget.
Disables video player outro unlock video guide bottom-right card.
Hides player comments and danmaku, disables danmaku sending, and preserves subtitle settings.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Disables internal Bilibili telemetry, APM profiling, TradPlus ad mediation, Firebase analytics, Crashlytics, and Facebook AppEvents.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Uses Morphe GmsCore for Google sign-in and sign-out.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Hides selected feed, splash, floating, push, overlay and under-player advertisements.

options.description: Also hides feed interest and rating questionnaires.
Hides feed advertisement cards and optionally interest and rating questions.
Disables bottom-right promotional floating advertisement overlay.
Disables top slide-down promotional toast and inner-push banner notifications.
Disables cold-start splash advertisement loading and countdown timer.
Disables video player in-stream bottom-right overlay ad banners.
Disables direct and SDK advertisements below the player while preserving access prompts.

patches.name: Remove user content
patches.description: Filters known user videos and creator surfaces, keeps Anime search, and preserves unknown official content and download management.
